items.title: Lawrence "Buddy" Tureaud Interview, 1972-03-06
items.q: I told my mother, I said, you know, sir, I got a good idea. I said, me and, uh, Captain Jones, the man, the head man at the home is good. I'm gonna see if I can get Cap to let Lewis come out of the home and play a little, uh, dance for you.

ctx.x: Uh, everybody was talking about Lewis Armstrong. He used to have a little band from the home, and every now and then they'd have a parade on Canal Street, and everybody would be talking about Lewis Armstrong. So, one day me and my mother was sitting in the kitchen, and I just had come from work. Mm-hmm. And, uh, I told my mother, I said, you know, sir, I got a good idea. I said, me and, uh, Captain Jones, the man, the head man at the home is good. I'm gonna see if I can get Cap to let Lewis come out of the home…
